description: Infiltrate Quantum Dynamics Corporation to identify and stop an insider threat. ENTROPY has recruited an employee to exfiltrate quantum-safe key material for the National Emergency-Services Dispatch Network. You have 4 hours to find the insider, gather evidence, and stop the acquisition before the 999 dispatch network's key-rotation window opens.
title: Insider Trading
learning_objectives: Identify indicators of insider threats through behavioural analysis
Correlate digital evidence (VM flags) with physical evidence (documents, interviews)
Exploit Bludit CMS via leaked credentials and authenticated image-upload remote code execution
Navigate complex moral decisions with lasting consequences
Understand ENTROPY's systematic recruitment and radicalisation methodology

challenges: Web Exploitation - authenticated Bludit image-upload RCE
User Access - Torres' exfiltration staging manifest

narrative_summary.act1: Arrive at Quantum Dynamics, a Home Office contractor near Cambridge, as a SAFETYNET security consultant. Meet CSO Patricia Morgan, interview staff and talk your way into the access you need.
narrative_summary.act2: Clone a staff badge off Owen's lanyard (or borrow Dr Halloran's), then talk Owen out of the server-room password with Patricia's log or her authority. Get Torres' office card on Patricia's authority and lift his print for the key vault. Build both halves of the case: why (the journal, the vetting file, the medical bills in his briefcase) and proof of exfiltration (the research portal flags, the data-centre paperwork). Name him to Patricia, in person or by phone. The Recruiter texts; ring her back and she offers a deal to leave her other targets unwarned.
narrative_summary.act3: Find Torres at the upload terminal in the data centre. Confront him with choices: turn as double agent, hand over to the police with cooperation, hand over without, combat (which resolves to a post-KO choice), or public exposure. No ending is ranked above another — each carries its own consequences. Then sweep the key vault and call HaX to be brought in.

key_npcs.name: Patricia Morgan
key_npcs.importance: Mission handler, provides security access and intelligence

key_npcs.name: Owen Gallagher
key_npcs.importance: His badge is cloned off his lanyard; holds the office spare and the server-room password, which he gives up for evidence or Patricia's authority, and names the key vault's reader

key_npcs.name: Dr Ruth Halloran
key_npcs.importance: Second route to a server-hallway badge; reacts to the accusation

key_npcs.name: Lisa Park
key_npcs.importance: Optional NPC, humanises Torres through family context

key_npcs.name: David Torres
key_npcs.importance: Primary antagonist, subject of confrontation with multiple unranked endings

key_npcs.name: The Recruiter
key_npcs.importance: Live phone antagonist, calls once Torres is identified and offers the player a deal

moral_complexity.primary_dilemma: Torres is both perpetrator (knowingly enabled a lethal delay to emergency dispatch) and victim (radicalised through medical debt). He's only 3 months into radicalisation - early enough to potentially save. The Recruiter argues the harder case: he made an informed choice, and forty-seven more candidates are already in her pipeline.
moral_complexity.entropy_portrayal: A systematic recruitment methodology run by people who calculate and approve civilian casualties as an acceptable cost. The Recruiter is unapologetic and persuasive, not a cartoon villain.
moral_complexity.player_agency: Multiple ending paths, unranked, with differences in campaign impact, Elena's treatment, and future intelligence gathering
